item.title: Failed by government insurance schemes, Niger women farmers turn to God
item.description: AGRICULTURAL insurance was designed to protect farmers from risk. But in Niger State, it has become another risk on its own. Many women farmers say they’ve lost more money chasing claims than to floods, pests, or drought.
